Looking at the qlang documentation, I'll write queries for each task. Let me work through them carefully, understanding the pipeline model and how to combine operations.

N1: /data/users | filter ~(if (/active | eq true) (at /email | ne null) (false)) | * (/email | split "@" | /1 | lower) | distinct | sort

N2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") | * ({:customer /customer/name :amount (:discount (at /discount | coalesce 0) | /lines | * (mul /qty /unit_price) | sum | sub discount)}) | groupBy ~/customer | * ({:name (/ | * /customer | first), :total (/ | * /amount | sum)}) | sort ~(/total) | reverse | take 2 | * ({:customer /name, :total (/total | round 2)})

N3: filter ~(eq /state "open") | * ((at /assignee | if . (/login) ("unassigned"))) | groupBy * | * count

N4: [(at /dependencies | coalesce {}) | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys | * keyword, (at /devDependencies | coalesce {}) | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys | * keyword] | flat | sort

N5: /services | filter ~(eq /enabled true) | ({:enabledCount (count), :ports (/ | * (at /port | coalesce null) | filter ~(ne null) | distinct | sort), :totalReplicas (/ | * (at /replicas | coalesce 1) | sum)})

N6: lines | filter ~(contains " ERROR ") | * ({:service (split "[" | /1 | split "]" | /0), :count 1}) | groupBy ~/service | * ({:service (/ | /service | first), :count (/ | /count | sum)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /service]) | take 2

N7: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | * (split ",") | filter ~(if (/2 | ne "") (/3 | ne "") (false)) | * ({:region (/0 | lower), :revenue (mul /2 /3)}) | groupBy ~/region | * (/ | * /revenue | sum | round 2)

N8: groupBy ~/user | filter ~(if ((/ | * (/type | lower)) | contains "login") (if ((/ | * (/type | lower)) | contains "logout") ~(false) ~(true)) ~(false)) | keys | * keyword | sort

N9: filter ~(at /salary | ne null) | groupBy ~/dept | * (:count (count) | (/ | * /salary | sum) | div /count | round 1)

N10: lines | filter ~(ne "") | * ((split ":" | /1 | split "," | * (lower | trim)) | distinct) | flat | distinct | sort

N11: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","apple","date"] | * (lower) | groupBy * | * ({:word /, :count (/ | count)}) | filter ~(/count | gt 1) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word])

N12: /releases | filter ~((eq /draft false) | if / (ne /prerelease true) (false)) | * ({:tag /tag_name, :downloads (/assets | * (at /download_count | coalesce 0) | sum)}) | sort ~(/downloads | mul -1) | take 3

N13: filter ~(/category | lower | eq "tools") | {:count (count), :allPriced (every ~(if (at /price) (gt 0) (false))), :inStockNames (. | filter ~(gt /stock 0) | * /name | sort)}

N14: lines | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(ne (startsWith "#")) | filter ~(ne (startsWith "-")) | filter ~(contains "==") | * (split "==" | :name (/0 | lower) | :{name /1}) | reduce {} ~(union)
